murals.line: 黑潮的年月·头一张撤离单
murals.name: 正午天黑
murals.text: Scene: noon, yet the sky has gone black. Wide view from just above the innermost of three ring walls, looking across the top of the city at the great round mouth of the labyrinth well. Out of the mouth a black tide boils upward in heavy rolling layers, fold over fold, rising until it fills the whole sky and blots out the daylight. Half-glimpsed in its folds: knights in armour of a forgotten age, a tall crowned figure with an empty face, a shadow wider than a city gate, and swarms of smaller monsters. At the very rim, lower centre, stands one small man seen from behind, facing the hole: a tiefling, tall and broad-shouldered, dark red hair tied in a single tail, two short horns angled back with an old bronze ring on the left one, plain grey cloak, a broad nameless sword in his right hand, his left fist clenched. The black parts around him like water around a rock and spills past on both sides; in the narrow untouched wedge behind him stand a low old tavern and a large stone hall. In the foreground the ring walls are crowded with tiny defenders raising horns and torches.
murals.light: Main light is the warm glow of torches strung along the ring walls and a faint pale-gold glow leaking from the man's clenched left fist; everything else sinks into ink-black and deep indigo.
murals.note: 选的是三幕幕终到收束头一拍：蝉鸣月中旬九日正午，潮翻出井口、天黑了，吉迪恩站在口子沿上，黑从他两边分开（源稿第228行；潮里那几样、身后没倒的罗茜的酒馆和旅印大厅照收束第231行；他的样子照第四页凡世至强守井人（圣座以后）仪容那一行，左掌心那一点淡金照第179、233行）。钩子那一句“第二十层，四个”在第二十层阶顶，第二页第二十层那一条也画在阶顶，同一处城、石栏、往下的石阶，怕两幅撞景，改画这一下，拿不准算不算这一条最认得出的一下。日头源稿写叫潮遮成发白的圆片，怕画成月亮，写成整片天黑透；钟楼的光环和光柱这时候都黑了，不画。墙上的火把是我添的。

murals.line: 黑潮的年月·头一回斩首
murals.name: 无面高座
murals.text: Scene: an underground plain that burns, low fires smouldering along cracked earth ridges that heave up and sink back. In the middle rises a huge, soft, white mountain, like ten thousand candles melted into one heap; pale human-shaped forms are melted into its slopes in layers, their open mouths all turned upward, singing. A dark channel burned by fire climbs one flank to the summit. On the summit stands a plain grey stone high seat without carving; on it sits a tall faceless figure, head bowed as if listening, and around the seat burns a ring of smokeless cold white fire with one gap in it. Through the gap one small man walks toward the seat: a tiefling with dark red hair in a tail, two short horns angled back with a bronze ring on the left one, grey cloak, a broad nameless sword drawn. High above the summit a night-wing woman circles: human-sized, large night-blue feathered wings with silver tips, shoulder-length pale violet hair; every open mouth on the mountain turns up toward her. At the top of the burned channel waits a tall fire-horn man, straight dark-tipped horns glowing at their cracks, a long hammer on his back.
murals.light: Main light is the cold white glow of the smokeless fire ring and the pale mountain, answered by low orange fires smouldering across the plain; the shadows are deep indigo and slate.
murals.note: 选三幕山顶那一下：芭丝报了全名走进白火、火圈开了口子，翡拉往上飞把那一团的唱全引过去，吉迪恩从口子里走向高座、剑已拔出还没砍（源稿第518到520行；山、高座、白火照第512行和迷宫｜第三十一层那一团第4703行，扎尔烧出的道照第517行；翡拉照第4300行，她是羽翼，跟派活说明夜翼多半是膜翼不一样，照源稿写）。不画砍头、缝口和九个人倒下的那几下。高座上那个是噬名者的残响缠着异界的那一截，只写没有脸，不点是谁。拿不准：山上一层一层张着嘴的人形会不会出得太吓人，主会话可以收成只写一层一层的白；题【雾门之外】说的是送人的那一队在雾门外头等，这一幅没画他们，要画就得换成第505到507行九个人穿过白雾门那一下。

murals.name: 门口的光
murals.text: Scene: a snowy courtyard at night below a great white wall, seen from above the horn platform at its west end, looking east. In the foreground two long rows of small adventurers stretch across the yard, one row facing the far gate, one facing the people; at the middle of the front row a towering woman with two short thick horns wrapped in hemp rope stands behind a tall iron door planted upright like a shield. Along the left side a file of refugees, mothers with children first, each holding a lit white candle, comes down terrace stairs toward the gate tunnel behind the viewer. On the platform a tall bone-white man with lilac hair holds a small bronze bell at his chest. Beyond them, empty snow. At the far end the broken east gate, door fallen inward, one gatehouse half collapsed; in the gap stands a lone knight in white-and-gold plate, platinum hair, sword sheathed, pale light leaking from his armour seams and twisting into many thin blade-shadows at his sides. Beyond, a bronze colossus far taller than the gate, an open door in its chest and crawling things on its back, bends to reach one arm over the threshold.
murals.light: Warm light comes from the long file of white candles and a pale gold light pours from the seams of the knight's armour; the snow, the wall and the colossus sit in blue-grey and slate shadow.
murals.note: 选二幕幕终，拂晓以前铜像弯腰把一条胳膊伸过门槛、门口的刃影要合的前一刻（源稿第857行；门口的莱恩哈特照第846行，线上两排和立在线当中的铁门照第845、853行，蜡烛照第829、855行；人照第920、976、1032行）。镜头放在号台上往东看，门洞在画外身后。莱恩哈特旧伤裂了、血顺着甲片滴，不画。题【扣在长凳上的碗】是第二天日中守将屋里的事（第868行），这一幅没画长凳。拿不准：雪拂晓前才停，写成地上的积雪、不写下着的雪；圭多胸口那一块露着肋骨，不画露骨，只写胸前那只钟；铜像是别的世界造来打仗的神像，跟七神无关，写成铜像。

murals.line: 黑潮的年月·白碑第七夜
murals.name: 门化灰雨
murals.text: Scene: night on a wide plain flooded with black tide, the tide lying flat on the ground like spilled ink. Far behind, across the whole horizon, runs a long white stone rampart; every banner along it glows softly as if lit from behind, and its own great gate stands whole and untouched. In the middle of the picture, alone in the black flood a few hundred paces in front of the rampart, stands a single old stone town gate with no wall around it, the ghost of a gate from a town that burned long ago: a stone gateway under a burning wooden lintel; inside its passage a row of small woven baskets and a tall pale figure at a little table, faces unclear. At the two ends of this gate's threshold, a gateway's width apart and not looking at each other, stand two women. Left: a woman with long silver-grey hair pinned loosely with a dark red ornament, dark red coat over one shoulder, black gown, bending to press a heavy seal onto the threshold stone with her bare right hand. Right: a tall woman with dark gold-brown hair tied low, copper chain mail and an old copper cloak, cutting a long sword low and flat along the ground. This old town gate cracks upward from its threshold and its burning lintel crumbles into grey ash falling like rain. From the threshold a straight path of pale gold light splits the black tide and runs toward the viewer, to rooftops in the foreground crowded with tiny people. The white rampart behind stays whole.
murals.light: Main light is the orange of the burning lintel turning to falling grey ash, the pale gold of the opened path and the soft lamp-like glow of every banner along the wall; the tide is ink-black and the night deep indigo.
murals.note: 选二幕两个王同时出手那一下：魔王把山铜王印压在门槛的石头上，凯撒贴着地往西斩，门从门槛往上裂、门楣化成灰雨，潮裂开一条底下亮着淡金的路，长垒上的军旗一齐亮（源稿第1193到1195行；门的样子照第1185行和地点｜灰雨城残响之门第4772行；两人照这一页凯撒、魔王两条人物第4102、4132行）。凯撒那一剑贴着地，写成平的，不画天上的弧光。巴尔缇娜人物条没写角，不画角。屋顶上的人在西边、长垒在东边，镜头摆成长垒在后、屋顶在前，路朝着看的人铺过来。拿不准：门四周潮变成的矮墙、烧着的房子、敲钟的街口为了省字没写进去，主会话要加可以加一句；门里篮子边报名字的白骸写成看不清脸的高个子。

murals.name: 钟台两侧
murals.text: Scene: night, looking along the top of a great white wall running straight into the distance, splitting the picture in two; more bell platforms recede along it. In the middle ground a square stone bell platform sits astride the wall, its small stone bell-arch holding one bronze bell, a rope hanging down each side. Back against its right face a slim flaxen-haired young man raises a dented brass trumpet, shouting; back against its left face stands a tall fire-horn woman, two short straight horns, black hair with a dark red sheen, a curved horn-bugle whose mouth glows with a small flame, shouting at the stone. Neither can see the other. Against the platform leans a slim snow-leopard-eared young woman with a long snow-grey braid and ringed tail, holding an old brass lamp, still lit. Below on the right: stepped terraces lined with soldiers facing outward, cannons pointing up, fields and old graves heaving up black tide. Below on the left: soldiers facing outward, a row of short black obsidian posts carrying one wire, red-brown wasteland with broken siege giants standing in mist as black tide rises. Ahead, a little to the left, a row of white fire bursts over the tide.
murals.light: Main light is the small flame at the horn-bugle's mouth and the warm glow of the brass lamp, set against a cold white flare from the row of bursts ahead; the wall is pale grey-blue and the tides on both sides are near-black.
murals.note: 选三幕下旬九日那一下：恩娜嗓子哑了唱不出来，莎菲雅隔着钟台喊说北南、几根杆，森克喊回去，两边的兵九百年头一回隔着墙直接传令，一刻钟以后魔晶弹在北边炸成一列白火（源稿第1561到1564行；钟台照第1530行，两坡照世道第1510行和开局第1508行；人照第1619、1731、1787行）。赫斯珀死在中旬九日，这一幅拿恩娜手里那盏从钟台脚下捡回来、没灭的旧铜灯代他（第1552、1640行）。镜头顺着长垒往北看，右边是东坡、左边是西坡，落点在钟台往北半里的西边潮里。拿不准：恩娜捡了灯以后到下旬九日是不是一直提着，源稿只写她擦了一夜挂上门边那面墙，这一下提在手里是我排的；钟架写成石拱，电报那一排写成不带横担的黑曜石柱，免得画出十字或者绞架；西坡的探照塔灯头是圆的，怕像月亮，没写。

murals.name: 花落成冠
murals.text: Scene: dawn inside a long royal hall with a pale white stone floor. At the far end seven steps rise to a throne whose armrest bears a carved wooden rose; an old white-haired king is walking down the steps. From the ceiling hangs a great rose-shaped lamp, burned out. At the foot of the steps lies a heap of offered flowers. Rose petals have just stopped falling and lie in one wide ring, like a crown, around the throne and the common families on one side of the hall; just above the ring hovers a low band of thin silver blade-light. Inside the ring people look down at themselves, unhurt. The floor is strewn with petals, dropped crossbows and swords; thin long scratches run across the stone from under the lamp to the steps. In the open middle stands a young woman knight with rose-gold hair loosely tied with a ribbon, light silver armour, a sprig of wild grass on her breast, slender sword lowered, its scabbard wrapped in dried flowers. A noble sits at the foot of the flower heap, petals on his shoulders. Among the families a tall woman with a crown of braids holds a bandaged arm.
murals.light: Pale cool dawn light falls from high narrow windows and mixes with the faint silver of the hovering blade-light; the dead lamp and the corners of the hall rest in soft lavender shadow.
murals.note: 这是凝名短主线，画伊索尔德凝名那一下：三幕幕终，最后一个名字念完、灯烧到底，花瓣落成一圈花冠、圈上浮起剑光、圈里的人身上一道伤也没有，王从七级台阶上走下来叫她花冠剑首（源稿第1891行；王厅照地点｜王厅第4862行，地上的剑痕照第1895行和第4864行；人照第1937、1993、4441行）。剑光那一圈写成贴着花冠的一道低低的光带，不写成悬在半空的光环。拿不准：王厅有没有窗源稿没写，高窗进来的晨光是我添的；公爵在花山底下坐下是第1890行天快亮的事，到这一下还坐着是顺着写的；西尔玛胳膊叫短刀擦破，只写包着的胳膊，不写血。

murals.name: 倒影不晃
murals.text: Scene: night at a lake city. In the foreground a broad flight of stone steps descends from a dock into black, glass-still water. On a low step kneels a tall, slender young man with long lake-blue hair loosely tied, a fine mist clinging to his hair and to his lake-green robe, a chisel and mallet in his hands; along the step beside him run seven fresh, shallow carved marks. Standing over him, a short young woman with messy ginger curls tied with a red cloth strip, freckles, an oilcloth jacket, bare feet, raises a lamp high. A few fisher children watch from the top of the steps. A sudden wind tugs at their hair and clothes. Across the lake lies a city of slim towers on the far shore and an old tower on an island, and a long bridge strung with hanging lamps spans the water. The lamplight lies in the lake as reflections, and in spite of the wind every reflection is perfectly still and sharp.
murals.light: Main light is the warm lamp in the woman's raised hand and the strings of hanging lamps on the far bridge, doubled perfectly in the still water; the rest is deep blue night and silver mist.
murals.note: 这是凝名短主线，画卢米安凝名那一下：三幕幕终，下旬十日南岸码头往湖里去的石阶上，他刻完第七个名字，妮侬举着灯，湖上起风，悬灯桥上的灯倒在水里、倒影一盏也没有晃，妮侬叫出湖影先知（源稿第2150行，凝名照收束第2153行；人照第2195、2251行）。七个名字只写成刻痕，不画字。拿不准：“灯一盏一盏倒在水里”我读成灯影映进水里，不是灯掉进湖里；把对岸的城连着灯影写成水底下倒过来的一座城，是想叫看的人认得出九十九座银湖城，源稿只说灯的倒影不晃，主会话觉得多了可以收成只有灯影。

murals.name: 雪墙之间
murals.text: Scene: dusk turning to night high above a snowbound mountain ridge that runs across the lower middle of the picture. A storm of tangled clouds and torn air fills the sky, but straight through it runs one long, perfectly straight corridor, as if sliced clean; on both sides of the corridor the wind has flung the snow up into two tall white walls, and between them shows clear night sky with a few small stars. Down the corridor glides a long string of small wooden sky-ships with patched sails, each carrying a lamp. On the prow of the leading old cargo ship stands a dragonkin woman with a long white braid, short white horns and silvery folded wing membranes, hanging her shed scales so that they shine in a line from prow to prow. At the far end of the corridor, leading them, a frost-white wyvern with clouded white eyes carries a lean rider with blue-grey hair and a long scarf flying, a single-edged long sword held out before him. Beside the slowest ship flies a huge grey eagle carrying a young knight in a sky-blue short cape.
murals.light: Main light is the warm string of ship lamps and the scales glinting along the prows, with the last cold afterglow lingering on the snow walls; the storm clouds and the open sky are deep indigo.
murals.note: 这是凝名短主线，画苍风凝名那一下：三幕中旬五日傍晚，山脊顶上空了一大片，霜嗝迎着冲过去，苍风劈开一道一里来长的口子，劈出去的风把雪扬成航线两边的雪墙，三十七艘一艘一艘从口子里滑过山脊（源稿第2406行，凝名照收束第2410行；船头挂鳞照第2404行；人照第2452、2508、2564行，霜嗝照第2384行）。口子写成笔直的一道，不画弧形的刀光，免得像月牙；索尔维源稿是往后弯的白角，写成短角。拿不准：三十七艘画不全，写成一长串；伦卡那一艘老货艇没单写船长；他肺叫寒压撕出血沫，不画。

murals.name: 门前暗火
murals.text: Scene: night at the deepest point of a dark underground pass, where two rock walls close in to their narrowest. A dozen worn stone steps, cut with deep grooves, rise to a colossal stone door taller than any city gate, with no bolt and no lock; it stands open, and only pure black seeps out from inside. On the top step, alone before the opening, stands a tall broad fire-horn man: straight horns with blackened tips, each split by two cracks glowing dark red, brick-red short hair, old leather armour with a small copper plate on the left shoulder, a wooden tag on a cord at his neck, a long-handled stone-splitting hammer resting at his side; his head is turned back over his shoulder. Three steps below him a grey-haired cartographer with a metal clip in his hair and a cloak lined with folded maps has stopped and looks back up at him, a small bronze seal held in his hand. At the foot of the steps lies an emptied leather water flask.
murals.light: The only light is the dark red glow from the cracks in the horned man's horns, warming the edge of the door and the steps around him; everything else is ink-black and deep indigo.
murals.note: 选三幕上旬六日夜里那一下：塔隆把旅印交给奥尔文，奥尔文走到第三级回头问他这一道门守到什么时候，塔隆说“这一块也是界碑”，正是钩子那一句（源稿第2699行；他在石阶底下喝完水、站到最上面那一级守五夜照第2697到2698行，石阶上的深沟照第2696行；人照第4517、4547行）。他第二天天亮把门劈倒、站在门底下没退，这一幅只画他站着的那一刻，不画门倒下来。那只手是那一位伸进来的投影，不画，门里只写黑。拿不准：石阶底下那只喝空的水壶是照第2697行添的；奥尔文左眼是白玻璃义眼，人太小画不出，没写。

notes: 头一张撤离单没画钩子那一下（第二十层阶顶），因为第二页第二十层那一条也在同一处阶顶，改画正午天黑、会长站在口子沿上；主会话要是觉得钩子更要紧，可以换成第211到213行瑞雯背着断腿的人从雾里上来、甘特站在灯底下朝第十九层喊那一下。
九幅的名字只跟这一页和任务单里的主线名、任务名对过，没跟另外几页的壁画名对过（那几份还没交），并稿时要再查一遍重名。
有立绘的几位（莱恩哈特、伊索尔德、卢米安、苍风、两个王）出图时可以拿立绘的头当长相参考；吉迪恩、塔隆前传那一套有没有立绘我没查。
日头、钟楼的光环、探照塔的灯头、凯撒那一剑和苍风那一刀这些圆的、弯的亮东西，我都没往天上放，出图以后还是要看一眼有没有长出像月牙的东西。
